retrievalProfile.description: A centered full-body portrait in a white suit against a textured blue-toned urban wall with large, overlapping italicized typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in a stark white suit and black hat stands against a heavily textured, cool-toned blue wall. The lower half of the image is blurred, creating a shallow depth of field that emphasizes the subject's face. Large, semi-transparent italicized sans-serif text is layered on the right side, partially overlapping the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the white suit and the deep blue-toned background
Textual overlap creating depth between the subject and the foreground
Vertical alignment of the subject centered against a horizontal textured plane
Selective blur in the foreground and lower third to direct focus upward
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue color grading across the entire environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central vertical axis, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and black fedora, providing the highest point of dark contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the white suit, then right to the large display text, and finally across the horizontal subtitle line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive textured wall on the left and right sides, treated with a cool blue wash.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blue and cyan tones in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the suit and text outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black for the hat and small serif typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blues, whites, and blacks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy italicized sans-serif and decorative serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, slanted strokes with a thin white outline
Secondary text uses a mix of standard sans-serif and stylized, high-contrast serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main name text features tight kerning and semi-transparency
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold italicized sans-serif paired with a centered horizontal line of mixed serif and sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides the clean sans-serif structure required for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a man in a white suit and black fedora, centered against a textured, blue-toned concrete wall. Apply a heavy blue color grade and blur the bottom third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, italicized lowercase text on the right side with a semi-transparent fill and white outline. Below it, add a horizontal line of smaller mixed-font text across the center.

verificationChecks: Is the display text italicized and outlined?
Is the bottom of the image blurred?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Transparency level of the display text
mustRedesign: Any use of warm colors (reds, oranges, yellows)
Sharp focus on the feet or floor
postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue tint is uniform across the background.
Ensure the white suit remains the brightest element.
Verify the text outline is crisp and visible against the background.
Confirm the subject's face is the sharpest point of focus.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(White Suit + Black Hat) + Background(Blue Grunge Wall) + Composition(Centered + Lower Blur) + Typography(Large Italic Outlined Sans-Serif)
